title:
Wandering Around
Touring the Base World

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
So this is the Landosol of this world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおーっ！
これがこっちの世界のランドソルか～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
Is it different from the Landosol in Aira's world?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうどう？
アイラの世界のランドソルと違う？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: In the margin of error! Probably♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
誤差の範囲！
たぶんね♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori & Aira
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text: あはははは！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
How about yours, Shinatsu?
Is it within the margin of error aswell?
text_block_list.orig_text:
シナツはどう？
誤差の範囲かな。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
...She's right.
They're quite alike.
I can't say for sure until I take a closer look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだな。
よく似ている。
詳しく見てみないと断言はできないが。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll show you two around!
It doesn't look like you'll be able to leave for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら二人を案内するよ！
まだしばらくは動けそうにないもんね。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
...We just went there to double check, but it seems like Shinatsu and I won't be able to enter the Sol Tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だねー
……ついさっき行って確定しちゃったけど
あたしとシナツちゃんは
ソルの塔に入れないみたいだし。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the investigation of Sol Tower to Fio and Nebbia.
And...
Yui and {0} will tackle Eris's whereabouts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソルの塔の調査については、
フィオとネビアに任せよう。
それと……
エリスの行方については、
ユイと{0}に。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Then what should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし。
ではどうするか。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Oh! About that... Why don't we split into two teams?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
それなんだけどね？
二つのチームに分かれてみない？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...So you're trying to leave me out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………
私を仲間外れにするつもりか……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: How did you end up with teams of three and one!?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうして三人と一人になる計算になるんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, of course it's going to be two teams of two♪
Rei-chan & Shinatsu-chan team, and...
Hiyori-chan & Me team! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははは、
トーゼン二人ずつだよ♪
レイちゃんとシナツちゃんチームと～……
ヒヨリちゃんとあたしのチームのね♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: You know, if there's too many people, we'll have to worry about group dynamics, right? I'd imagine there are plenty of stories that we'd like to tell too, right? To each other♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
あんまり大人数だと
団体行動で気を使うし？
なんやかんや積もる話もあるでしょ？
お互いにさ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ......To each other, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………お互いに、
か。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...Quite a loaded phrase.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……含みのある言葉だな。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
So, are we okay with this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
それじゃあ、
そんな感じで大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
If we're all good, let's split up here!
If anything happens, we'll meet up with you right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫そうなら、
ここで解散しちゃおうか！
何かあったら、
すぐに合流ね！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ok.
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かった。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...I have no objections.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……私も異論はない。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided!
Rei-chan, Shinatsu-chan! Enjoy your tour through Landosol~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ決定ね！
レイちゃんシナツちゃん、
よいランドソル観光を～♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Enjoy your tour through Landosol~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: よいランドソル観光を～♪

text_block_list.name: Rei & Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ああ。
